DOAS Power Analysis

Source: R/doas_power.R
doas_power.Rd

Runs multiple simulations to evaluate the statistical performance (bias, precision, coverage) of the DOAS estimator under varying sampling efforts. Supports multi-covariate simulation and modeling on detection (p_formula, p_betas) and abundance (n_formula, n_betas).

Usage

doas_power(
  n_sims = 100,
  surv_areas = c(2, 4, 6),
  pop_size = 1000,
  mean_group = 10,
  tot_areas = 15,
  area_sizes = NULL,
  det_p1 = 0.6,
  intra_group_det = 0.9,
  det_group = 0.9,
  obs_effect = 0.75,
  detvar = 0.05,
  p_formula = NULL,
  p_betas = NULL,
  n_formula = NULL,
  n_betas = NULL,
  covariates = NULL,
  cov_effect = 0,
  n_cov_effect = 0,
  method = c("ML", "Bayes", "frequentist", "bayesian"),
  obs_type = c("independent", "dependent"),
  pooling = c("hybrid", "global"),
  ci_method = c("lognormal", "bootstrap")
)

Arguments

n_sims

Number of simulations to run per scenario.

surv_areas

Vector of Double Observer survey efforts to test (number of DO sectors).

pop_size

Average total population size for simulate_pop.

mean_group

Average group size for simulate_pop.

tot_areas

Total number of survey sectors.

area_sizes

Vector of probabilities/sizes for assigning groups to sectors. If NULL, uniform or covariate-driven probabilities are used.

det_p1

Base detection probability for Observer 1.

intra_group_det

Mean factor for count errors.

det_group

Base detection factor for group size scaling.

obs_effect

Observer 2 relative efficiency.

detvar

Standard deviation for detection probability across sectors.

p_formula

Optional detection formula passed to simulation and doas (e.g., ~ effort + elevation).

p_betas

Optional named numeric vector of logit coefficients for p_formula in simulate_survey.

n_formula

Optional abundance formula passed to simulation and doas (e.g., ~ elevation + forest).

n_betas

Optional named numeric vector of log-linear coefficients for n_formula in simulate_pop.

covariates

Optional data frame of sector-level covariates.

cov_effect

Numeric log-odds effect of a single simulated detection covariate (covariate) (retained for backward compatibility).

n_cov_effect

Numeric log-linear effect of a single simulated abundance covariate (habitat) (retained for backward compatibility).

method

Statistical inference paradigm ("ML", "Bayes", "frequentist", or "bayesian"). Default is "ML".

obs_type

Observer field protocol ("independent" or "dependent").

pooling

Sector pooling strategy ("hybrid" or "global").

ci_method

Confidence interval method ("lognormal" or "bootstrap").

Value

A data frame summarizing performance metrics for each scenario in surv_areas: - surv_areas: Number of DO sectors surveyed - successful_sims: Number of simulations that returned valid estimates - mean_true_N: Average simulated actual population size - mean_est_N: Average estimated population size - rel_bias: Relative bias ((mean_est / mean_true) - 1) - rmse: Root Mean Squared Error - coverage: Proportion of simulations where true pop fell within the 95% CI - mean_cv: Mean Coefficient of Variation (SE / Estimate)
